source.publication: 2025 Kentucky Form 740 packet with instructions (Kentucky Department of Revenue), with 2025 Form 740, Schedule M, Schedule P and Schedule ITC
source.section: Form 740 (2025) page 1 lines 5-19 and page 2 lines 20-22 (740_2025.pdf PDF pp.1-2); packet PDF p.13 Line 5, Lines 6-9 (Kentucky AGI), Line 10 'Nonitemizers, enter the standard deduction of $3,270 ... If filing a joint return, only one $3,270 standard deduction is allowed', Line 11, Line 12 'Multiply line 11 by four percent (.04)'; packet PDF p.3 'For 2025, the standard deduction is $3,270' and 'the tax rate for individual income tax is 4%'; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section B line 1 (taxpayer) and line 5 (spouse) 'If you were 65 on or before 12/31/2025, enter 40'; Form 740 lines 16-18 (line 18: if line 17 is larger than line 16, enter zero); packet PDF p.14 Line 17; Schedule ITC (2025) PDF p.2 Section C Family Size Tax Credit Table (family size one: not over 15,650 100% ... over 20,815 0; family size two: not over 21,150 100% ... over 28,130 0); packet PDF p.26 Worksheet for Computation of Modified Gross Income lines (a)-(j) and Section C family size definitions; packet PDF p.11 Modified Gross Income; packet PDF p.14 Line 20 and Line 21 (MGI 42,760 or less); Form 740 page 2 lines 20-22 (line 21: line 19 times the decimal from Schedule ITC)

worked: Single, 70, interest 16,000: both the 40 age credit and the Family Size Tax Credit apply. Form 740 takes the 40 on line 17 first; line 21 is the family size share of line 19, the tax after it. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = interest 16,000.00 = 16,000.00. Federal taxable income = 16,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = -1,750.00 floored at 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 740, Filing Status 1 (single). Line 5 federal AGI 16,000.00. Line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 = 16,000.00. Schedule M line 17 total subtractions 0.00; Form 740 line 8 0.00. Line 9 Kentucky AGI = 16,000.00 - 0.00 = 16,000.00. Line 10 standard deduction 3,270.00; line 11 taxable income = 16,000.00 - 3,270.00 = 12,730.00. Line 12 tax = 12,730.00 x 0.04 = 509.20; lines 13 and 15 0.00; line 14 and line 16 509.20. Schedule ITC Section B: person 0 (age 70) 40; under-65 persons 0; line 17 = 40.00; line 18 = 509.20 - 40.00 = 469.20. Line 19 = 469.20. Modified gross income worksheet: (a) 16,000.00; (c) non-Kentucky municipal interest 0.00; (e) 16,000.00; (f) Kentucky AGI 16,000.00; (i) 16,000.00; (j) greater = 16,000.00. Line 20 family size 1 (single, no qualifying children); Schedule ITC Section C table: MGI 16,000.00 is over 15,650 but not over 16,276, so 90% (.90); line 21 = 469.20 x 0.9 = 422.28. Line 22 = 469.20 - 422.28 = 46.92. Credits = 40.00 + 422.28 = 462.28; state income tax 46.92. The form enters whole dollars; expected keeps the formula result to the cent. Taken in the other order (90% of 509.20 = 458.28, then 40) the tax would be 10.92; the form's order gives 46.92.
accepted_approximations: The Family Size Tax Credit is a share of the tax after the personal tax credits (Form 740 line 19 after line 17), so a consumer must apply it after the 40 age credit.
